entries.comment: STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-SCRIPT-001: Start the final Phase 11 clause and evidence audit.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-SCRIPT-001: Resolve the registered study and isolated signing authority before freezing.
STEP LOG P11-TEST-SCRIPT-001: Start the full repository regression from the canonical Phase 11 entrypoint.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-SCRIPT-001: Validate that the separately controlled custody workspace exists without reading its hidden content.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-001: Verify final freeze signature and byte identity of every frozen artifact.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-002: Reconcile every public Phase 9A design, allocation, signature, and ciphertext hash.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-003: Scan the development repository for custody-source, seed, key, or held-out-domain exposure.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-004: Execute the custody preflight and preserve a blocked outcome without consuming the one-shot state.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-005: Inventory every Phase 11 console event and its adjacent identifying comment with exact line numbers.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-BLOCK: Retain a nonzero, zero-misrepresentation verdict for every unresolved Phase 11 gate.
STEP LOG P11-AUDIT-006: Emit completion only after every WorkPlan gate has passed with immutable evidence.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-001: Verify the complete signed Phase 9A public commitment before constructing the method freeze.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-002: Prove every Phase 10 candidate file remains byte-identical before adding Phase 11 control code.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-003: Verify the final signature and every frozen file after writing the authoritative manifest.
STEP LOG P11-FREEZE-004: Retain the final method-freeze identity without authorizing a scientifically incomplete unlock.
STEP LOG P11-TEST-001: Discover the complete repository unit, integration, property, and stress suite.
STEP LOG P11-TEST-002: Retain the exact full-suite verdict without treating contract tests as a successful blind-bank release.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-001: Verify the signed freeze and all frozen artifacts before any custody request.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-002: Reverify the Phase 9A signature, public hashes, and ciphertext identities at the unlock boundary.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-002A: Rehash every committed custody-only design artifact without exposing its bytes or scientific content.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-003: Require signed plaintext identities, counts, bank allocations, and allocation binding before decryption.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-004: Authorize exactly one custody submission only after every fail-closed precondition passes.
STEP LOG P11-UNLOCK-BLOCK: Record the exact pre-unlock failure while preserving ciphertext, keys, and one-shot custody state.
